origin: BUG-FIX patch on top of v3, 2026-10-18, requested by the user after research/server_clock_check/README.md proved the FP Markets server clock is NY close + 7 (UTC+3 from the 2nd Sunday of March to the 1st Sunday of November, UTC+2 otherwise; follows US DST, not EU DST). v3's flat FixHourServer=18 is therefore 1 hour early on EU/US DST-mismatch days (London 16:00 = 19:00 server), so on those days v3 traded 15:00 London, not the fix, and fed non-fix samples into the spike history. Next live occurrence: 2026-10-29/30. v4 makes two changes and nothing else: (1) DST-aware fix hour, (2) magic-isolated position handling. Thesis, trigger math, thresholds, sizing, SL/TP, hold time, calendar filter, safety ledger and panel layout are unchanged. Spec written by the orchestrator as a pure correctness fix (no strategy-logic decision involved); Researcher reviews the backtest diff.
thesis: Unchanged from v1/v2: large asset managers, pension funds, and corporates rebalance currency hedges at month-end based on that month's realized equity performance, with flow concentrating in the final 2-3 trading days and peaking on the last day, specifically around the London 4pm fix. Hypothesis: fix-window spikes on these specific days are more often genuine flow-driven (and thus more reliably reversion-prone) than an average day's spike.

entry.calendar_filter: only trade if today is within TradeLastNDaysOfMonth (3 default) calendar days of month-end
entry.measurement_window: Fix time = 18:00 server normally, 19:00 server on mismatch days (see dst_fix); window = fix-5min to fix+2min (15:55-16:02 London on every day). History feed uses the same per-day fix time.
entry.trigger: fix-window move >= max(MinSpikeSizePipsFloor, MinSpikeVsAvgMultiplier * rolling average of the fix window's own recent history, fed every day regardless of the calendar filter)
entry.side: fade -- sell if price rose into the fix, buy if it fell
entry.safety_gate_added_in_v3: immediately before the threshold/spread/sizing checks, entry is additionally suppressed if monthlyHaltActive || dailyHaltActive || drawdownHaltActive -- see safety_ledger below. Never changes which spikes qualify or how size/SL/TP are computed when a trade IS allowed through.

stop_loss: spike size * SLMultiplier (1.0 default) -- unchanged from v1/v2
take_profit: spike size * TPMultiplier (1.0 default) -- unchanged from v1/v2

exit.rule: market close 30 minutes after the measurement window closes if SL/TP not hit, or end-of-day flat at 22:00 server -- unchanged; both closes now act only on this EA's own position (magic + symbol), by ticket.

position_sizing.note: CalculateLotSize() logic byte-for-byte unchanged from v1/v2 (risk % of ACCOUNT_EQUITY, round down to volume step, skip trade below broker minimum).

tunable_parameters_to_sweep: Unchanged from v1/v2 -- not the subject of this version. TradeLastNDaysOfMonth (3 default), MinSpikeVsAvgMultiplier -- not yet swept.

safety_ledger.change: Backfilled the full standard safety ledger, copied line-for-line from strategies/day_trading/gotobi/v1/strategy.mq5: input int InpMaxConsecutiveLosses=6 + consecutiveLosses counter incremented/reset in a new OnTradeTransaction() handler keyed on MagicNumber+_Symbol+DEAL_ENTRY_OUT+profit sign; monthlyHaltActive+haltSetYear+haltSetMonth+CheckMonthlyHaltResume() (halt lifts on the first day of the next calendar month, same cadence rationale as gotobi since this strategy also evaluates every month, just with a narrower few-day window inside it); input double InpDailyLossStopPercent=5.0 + dailyStartBalance (captured in ResetDayState(), which already ran once per day) + dailyHaltActive + UpdateDailyLossHalt(); input double InpMaxDrawdownStopPercent=15.0 + balancePeak + drawdownHaltActive + UpdateDrawdownHalt(); input bool InpResetLedgerNow=false and InpResetDrawdownStop=false for manual clearing. All three halt flags are OR'd into a single gate checked in OnTick() immediately before v2's existing threshold/spread/sizing checks in the entry path -- structurally identical placement to gotobi's own 'if(monthlyHaltActive || dailyHaltActive || drawdownHaltActive) return;' gate.
safety_ledger.scope: Can only SUPPRESS a trade v2 would have taken (any trade that would open while a halt is active this version now skips it) -- cannot add a trade v2 would not have taken. Zero entry/exit/threshold/sizing/timing logic changed otherwise.
safety_ledger.backtest_impact: NOT a no-op, unlike v2's InpAllowLiveAccount patch. Because this strategy has historically strung together consecutive losing months in its own backtest history (per v1/v2 review.md), the consecutive-loss/daily-loss/drawdown gates are expected to fire at least occasionally within the existing in-sample/out-of-sample windows, which can only reduce v3's total trade count and shift PF/drawdown numbers relative to v2 -- possibly for the better (removing tail-risk clusters) or the effective PF could look different either way. v2's review.md/VERDICT.md numbers must NOT be assumed to carry over -- this version requires a fresh in-sample backtest (and, if it still looks live-worthy, a fresh out-of-sample validation) before any live/demo status decision is made on it.
safety_ledger.requested_by: Orchestrator/user, 2026-09-23, closing the gap identified in ea-coder/lessons.md's month_end_fix_reversal/v2 entry (v2 only ever added the InpAllowLiveAccount gate, not the rest of the standard ledger).

chart_panel.change: Added the Comment()-based on-chart status panel required by .claude/agents/ea-coder.md's 'Chart status panel' convention: identity/DEMO-LIVE line, Validated: line (input string InpValidatedSymbols, comma-separated, seeded from this spec's "symbol" field), Risk/trade + DD-from-peak line, Status line (RUNNING / HALTED:<reason> / INIT FAILED:<reason> / WARNING: SYMBOL NOT VALIDATED FOR THIS EA), Safety: losses X/Y line, Position line, Last: line, then an EA-specific block showing today's month-end-window eligibility (day X of month vs TradeLastNDaysOfMonth), the fix window's start/end and scheduled exit clock times, and the spike-history state (spikeHistoryCount/SpikeHistoryWindow samples, current rolling average, current adaptive threshold). Refreshed every OnTick() and via a 1-second OnTimer(); rendered before the INIT_FAILED return on the live-account guard too; cleared with Comment("") in OnDeinit().
chart_panel.scope: Display only -- reads existing/new state variables, never influences any trading decision.

demo_criteria.rationale: Unchanged from v1/v2. Low frequency by design (only ~3 trading days/month qualify at all, further filtered by the spike threshold, now also by the new safety halts) -- similar low-frequency profile to gotobi, anchor adjusted accordingly rather than the standard day_trading category anchor.

dst_fix.rule: A date is a mismatch day if (date >= 2nd Sunday of March AND date < last Sunday of March) OR (date >= last Sunday of October AND date < 1st Sunday of November), evaluated on the server calendar date from TimeCurrent(). Never use TimeGMT() (not simulated in the Tester).
dst_fix.effect: On mismatch days the fix hour is FixHourServer + 1 (19:00). Everything derived from fixTime (windowStart, windowEnd, scheduledExitTime) shifts with it. EndOfDayHour=22 is unchanged.
dst_fix.input: input bool InpDstMismatchShift = true; // false reproduces v3's flat 18:00 timing (diagnostic only)
dst_fix.panel: EA block shows 'DST mismatch day: YES/no' next to the fix window line; panel title says v4.
dst_fix.verification: Backtester confirms from the journal that every trade on a mismatch date opened at 19:02 server and every other trade at 18:02 server; and that with InpDstMismatchShift=false the EURUSD.r in-sample result matches v3 exactly.

position_isolation.bug: v3 line ~473: 'if(HourOf(now) >= EndOfDayHour && PositionSelect(_Symbol)) trade.PositionClose(_Symbol);' closes ANY position on the symbol after 22:00 server, including other EAs' or manual positions, with no magic check. Lines ~382/~481 use PositionSelect(_Symbol), which on a hedging account selects an arbitrary position on the symbol, so another EA's position can hide this EA's own (missed scheduled exit) or be read as ours.
position_isolation.fix: Replace every PositionSelect(_Symbol) with a helper that loops PositionsTotal()/PositionGetTicket(i) and returns the ticket of the first position with POSITION_SYMBOL == _Symbol AND POSITION_MAGIC == MagicNumber (0 if none). Close by ticket (trade.PositionClose(ticket)). Apply to the end-of-day close, the scheduled exit, the 'already in a position' check, and the panel.
position_isolation.backtest_impact: None expected in single-EA backtests (only one EA, one position at a time).

backtest_plan.approved_live_scope: EURUSD.r and GBPUSD.r only (USDJPY held back per approval).
runs: EURUSD.r in-sample with InpDstMismatchShift=false (dst_off_check/) -- must match v3 exactly
backtest_plan.settings: Same as v3 config.ini (Model=4, Login=YOUR_ACCOUNT_LOGIN, Deposit 10000 USD, Leverage 100), all other inputs at v3 values.
